caseNameFull: Keith THARPE, applicant v. Eric SELLERS, Warden.

opinions.text: The application for stay of execution of sentence of death presented to Justice THOMAS and by him referred to the Court is granted pending the disposition of the petition for a writ of certiorari. Should the petition for a writ of certiorari be denied, this stay shall terminate automatically. In the event the petition for a writ of certiorari is granted, the stay shall terminate upon the sending down of the judgment of this Court.
